chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 603 – Li Huowang Arms Himself at the Dock
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang calls Yang Na in disguise, silences a witness with a boning knife, and prepares to infiltrate the dock where Xu Shou waits. Every move is desperate.
og_description: A bus ride, a panicked witness, and a kitchen knife. Li Huowang is all alone in the modern world—and he’s getting ready for war.
twitter_title: Ch. 603: Li Huowang Tapes a Man to a Toilet
twitter_description: Li Huowang calls Yang Na, threatens Old Liu with a saw, and picks up a boning knife. The dock is his next battlefield.

lore_anchors.definition: A heavy kitchen knife designed for cutting meat away from bone. Li Huowang chooses it over a smaller saw because he expects a real fight—one that requires reach and force, not ritual precision.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang block Yang Na’s number?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He can’t risk her calling him back or being tracked through his phone. Cutting contact is a brutal but necessary way to keep her safe from Xu Shou.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Li Huowang really going to kill Old Liu?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No—he’s past wanton murder. Taping him to a toilet and stealing his kitchen knife is a practical, if violent, way to buy time without leaving a corpse.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang pick a boning knife instead of the saw?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The saw is short and ritualistic; the boning knife has reach and can slash effectively. He’s optimizing for a real fight, not a self-sacrifice ritual.
